id: title:Gilbert09:stop retrying an ambiguous column query

review.posthog_relevance: Adds deterministic, non-retryable classification for BigQuery column-name ambiguity errors, preventing repeated failed ingestion attempts against a customer's view definition.
review.reason: Adds a new non-retryable error entry for BigQuery's ambiguous column error, including a comment explaining the deterministic failure and a test asserting the error is recognized.
review.uncertainty: While the code change is substantive and bounded, the complete implementation and relevant checks are not fully visible; the tier is assigned based on the supplied hunk observations.

observations.limitations: Only supplied hunk IDs are cited. No score assigned.

observations.behavior: Adds a new non-retryable error entry for BigQuery's ambiguous column error, including a comment explaining the deterministic failure and a test asserting the error is recognized.
observations.code_quote: "is ambiguous": "BigQuery couldn't run a query for this source because a column name in the table or view being synced is ambiguous. This usually happens when a view joins tables that share a column name, or two columns differ only by letter case. Retrying won't help — please update the view or table definition to remove the naming conflict (for example by aliasing the duplicate column), then reconnect the source.",

observations.behavior: Adds a parametrized test with two sample error messages, including one with a row:col location and one without, asserting that the ambiguous column error is recognized as non-retryable.
